name: Overclockers UK graphics card listings (new, and out-of-stock RTX 4090)
notes: Fetched 2026-10-03. Recorded as a UK-region channel for consumer and workstation accelerators. A live observation: Asus GeForce RTX 4090 ROG Strix OC 24GB was shown at GBP 2,299.99, marked 'Price reduced from GBP 2,539.99' - i.e. new-channel RTX 4090 stock in the UK had fallen to roughly 1.6x the best US used-4090 asking price. NOT a used/refurb price: Overclockers UK does not publish a refurbished accelerator tier in the extracted page. PayPal-protected, 3-year in-store warranty model typical of the UK channel.
